THE ROOST IS VULNERABLE. THE FOREST HAS NOTICED.

Hold The Roost is a tactical tower-defense survival game about turning a helpless chicken yard into a fortress — and a flock into an army.

Use the daylight to build new defenses, manage your flock, hatch eggs, configure tower loadouts and prepare for the next attack. When night falls, light the fires, man the towers, send your looters out to work, and defend the roost while the forest closes in.

Every chicken matters. Every egg could become your next champion. How long can your roost survive?

BUILD BY DAY. SURVIVE BY NIGHT.

Use the daylight to build towers, campfires and traps, organize your flock, hatch new chickens, and configure your defenses for the threats ahead.

When night falls, your plan is put to the test. Shooters man the defenses while Looters venture out to gather the resources you'll need to keep building. Survive increasingly dangerous predators, learn where your defenses are weakest, and prepare to do it better the next day.

EVERY CHICKEN HAS A JOB.

Assign chickens as shooters, looters, or brooders, putting their individual strengths where they'll matter most. Build a team that can fight, gather, incubate and keep the roost running while everything around it is trying to eat them.

BUILD A LOADOUT — NOT JUST A TOWER.

Equip towers with different weapons, ammunition, targeting behavior, and specialized chickens to define your defensive strategy.

Tell a weapon to stay locked on until its target dies or reconsider after every shot. Prioritize the healthiest, fastest, closest or farthest enemy and combine those rules with ammunition effects to build more effective boss killers, crowd controllers and status spreaders.

Assign your best shooters with optimal stats for damage, attack speed, and attack range.

YOU CAN'T SHOOT WHAT YOU CAN'T SEE.

Darkness is a variable on the battlefield.

Campfires reveal approaching predators and define where your defenses can see. Light the right areas, extend your coverage and use burning enemies to keep threats exposed even after they disappear back into the night.

THE PREDATORS DON'T PLAY FAIR.

These aren't just bags of health marching in.

Foxes can tunnel past defenses. Snakes can shed negative effects. Powerful elite enemies can interfere with traps, visibility and the battlefield itself.

Learn what each predator is capable of — then build a defense specifically designed to ruin its night.

HATCH THE NEXT GENERATION.

Incubate and hatch new chickens with their own stats and potential. When a special chicken emerges, use a Medal of Eggcellence to recruit it into your permanent collection and bring your strongest cluckers into future runs.

GROW STRONGER. DEFINE YOUR STRATEGY.

As the fight progresses, invest Skill Points into upgrades that improve your defenses and open new ways to shape your strategy.

Strengthen the parts of your setup you rely on most, compensate for weaknesses, or build toward specialized combinations that make your flock and fortifications work better together.

There isn’t one correct build — just the one you’re betting the roost on.

WHEN SURVIVING THE LEVEL ISN’T ENOUGH.

Clearing a level doesn’t necessarily mean the fight is over. Prepare for the long night.

After surviving the required nights, you can push your defenses into Challenge Mode — an escalating endurance battle that will test your defenses, flock and strategy you developed during the run.

Survive endless, increasingly dangerous waves, build your score and compete on the leaderboards to see how far your preparation can carry you.

The last lights still burn. The dead do not rest.

Hold the Dawn is a 3D tower defense game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. By day, you rebuild and expand your stronghold. By night, the horde comes. Choose a hero with a distinct fighting style—they battle on their own while you command the defense: place towers, shape the battlefield, and keep the base standing until sunrise.

A Day to Build. A Night to Survive.

Daylight is scarce. Use it to raise defenses, deploy towers, and upgrade your base before the next assault. Every placement is a bet on how the night will unfold—choke points, overlapping fire, fallback lines.

When darkness falls, zombies surge across the wastes. Your towers open fire. Your hero auto-fights in the thick of the swarm. Cut them down, hold the line, and make it to dawn.

Heroes Who Fight. You Who Decide.

Each survivor brings a different edge to the field. Unlock new heroes and grow their abilities as you progress, so the next night starts stronger than the last. You set the plan. They hold it.

Towers With Tactical Weight

A varied arsenal of defensive structures—damage, control, and support—meant to be combined, not stacked blindly. The right layout breaks a wave. The wrong one collapses.

Hold the Line Together

Play solo, or defend the base with friends. Local, LAN, or Steam online.

Features

  • 3D post-apocalyptic tower defense

  • Day-build / night-defend loop

  • Distinct auto-fighting heroes

  • Tactical defensive towers

  • Satisfying horde-clearing combat

  • Base-building and upgrade strategy

  • Meta progression: unlock new content and strengthen heroes

  • Solo or multiplayer: local, LAN, and Steam online

HOLD THE LAST GATE
The waves don't stop at one map. Build your defenses, then watch the front bleed across every world at once.

DEFEND
Place and upgrade towers along the enemy path. Match damage types to what's coming, manage your power grid, and read each wave before it breaks. Run dry on energy and your line collapses.

SURVIVE & BUILD
Harvest resources from the world, craft your arsenal, and expand your foothold. Your gear, your stockpile, and your progress carry with you from map to map.

FIGHT
When towers aren't enough, step in yourself! Melee, ranged, and a swappable loadout put you on the front line alongside your defenses.

CROSS THE MEMBRANE
Unlock new maps and push the frontier outward. The wave flows across all of them simultaneously — defend one gate while the others hold the line.

Meet Rudy.

When Santa turns the North Pole into a war machine, the only one standing in his way is Rudy — a big-hearted, in-over-his-head reindeer with a gift for making friends (and enemies) wherever he goes. Busted out of the workshop dungeon and chased into the snow, Rudy rallies an unlikely alliance of holiday misfits to defend the season. Holiday Alliance is a bright, funny tower-defense  adventure set in the Holiday Lands.

Lead Rudy's alliance. Rudy fights on the front line himself — an unstoppable wall who blocks the horde while your towers do the work — backed by larger-than-life heroes who lunge, cleave, and turn the tide. Deploy them, position them, and hold the line.

Build a festive arsenal. Forget fixed slots — place your defenses anywhere off the path. Line up Party Popper cannons, single-target Roman Candles, crowd-slowing Disco Balls, blazing Sparklers, and frost-blasting Snow Blowers, then dig into deep specialization trees to shape each tower your way.

Master elemental combos. Freeze a swarm with frost, then shatter it with a well-timed blast. Set enemies ablaze with stacking fire. Mix damage types to counter armored Nutcrackers, splitting Snowmen, healing ballerinas, and the thundering Dasher boss.

Laugh through the story. Rudy's journey is a comic, character-driven campaign told in storybook cutscenes — full of heart, bad puns, and a twist you won't see coming.

What's inside

  - A story-driven Chapter 1 campaign: 15 levels

  - Play Rudy and his allies as deployable heroes who block, cleave, and lunge

  - Free-placement tower defense with deep upgrade specializations

  - A fire / frost / physical elemental combat system with burns, stuns, and shatter combos

  - A festive cast of holiday towers and enemies

  - Cozy, colorful, family-friendly storybook art

  Holiday Alliance: Chapter 1 is the first campaign in a growing holiday saga. Wishlist now and defend the season at launch!

Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG built around dungeon crawling, loot, character growth, and the slow uncovering of something ancient beneath the earth.

The mining town of Gravesend Hollow has sealed its lower shafts after children vanished and the dead began to stir below. What remains beneath the town is more than a mine. It is an old prison, a forgotten reliquary, and the resting place of something that should never have been found.

Descend through dangerous dungeon levels filled with undead, monsters, corrupted miners, hidden chambers, treasure, and secrets. Fight in real time, collect weapons and armor, identify magical items, improve your build, and push deeper toward the source of the corruption.

Features:

- Old-school action RPG dungeon crawling

- Real-time combat with melee weapons, ranged attacks, spells, and abilities

- Loot-driven progression with weapons, armor, jewelry, magic items, rare items, and uniques

- Character growth through attributes and ability choices

- A dark fantasy world centered on Gravesend Hollow and the sealed mines beneath it

- Town services including healing, shops, repairs, identification, and other survival tools

- Lore fragments and secrets that reveal the history of the world and the angel buried below

Hollow is being developed as a focused single-player ARPG for players who enjoy dark atmosphere, dungeon exploration, loot hunting, and classic RPG progression.

You find yourself stranded in the city with no idea why. However, to survive and ultimately escape, you must gather loot and prepare from your base.

Solo or up to 4-Player Co-op

In a city that seems to have nothing left but despair, you must find a way out. You can choose to face this challenge alone, or team up with reliable allies. Scour various themed districts for weapons and supplies. Sometimes you'll find what you need in a discarded trash can; other times, you'll have to take it by force. Remember: in this dying world, others are always looking to steal what’s yours.

Survivors who help you in their own way

One hands you the supplies you need, another passes along better gear, and someone else tends to your wounds when you come back from outside. And as you keep venturing out to explore, you may come across other survivors willing to join you. Though of course, you'll have to be just as willing to help them with their own troubles.

HolyMoly is a chaotic third-person roguelite defense shooter where weird heroes protect the sacred Golden Cow from endless enemy waves, absurd bosses and total fantasy disaster.

Play solo or team up in online co-op. Choose your hero, build ridiculous upgrade combinations, open chests, repair your defenses, survive escalating maps and try to keep the Holy Cow alive long enough to regret your decisions.

PROTECT THE HOLY COW

The Golden Cow is not decoration. It is the heart of your base, your final objective and the one thing enemies absolutely should not touch. Hold the Castle Gate, repair what breaks, survive the pressure and defend the Cow at all costs.

BUILD ABSURD HEROES

Choose from strange, loud and dangerous heroes with their own weapons, skills and Ultimate abilities. Every run pushes your character in a different direction through upgrades, utility choices and questionable power spikes.

SURVIVE ESCALATING ENEMY WAVES

Each map throws stronger waves, stranger threats and boss encounters at you. Some maps test your defense across fixed wave challenges. Others push the chaos even further.

CHOOSE YOUR UPGRADES

Level up during the run and pick upgrade cards that improve your stats, skills, character power and defensive utility. Your build can become heroic, broken, stupid or all three at once.

OPEN CHESTS. TAKE RISKS. GET WEIRDER.

Earn gold, find chests, upgrade your weapons and interact with strange map objects. Some choices make you stronger. Some choices may become a problem very quickly.

PLAY SOLO OR ONLINE CO-OP

Defend the Holy Cow alone or with a friend in online co-op. Split pressure, cover each other, repair objectives and try not to blame your teammate when everything explodes.

A FANTASY DEFENSE GAME THAT REFUSES TO BE NORMAL

HolyMoly mixes action roguelite progression, third-person combat, base defense, comedy, fantasy chaos and one extremely important cow-related emergency.

Remaster

Homeplanet is a remaster of a game originally released in Russia in 2003. It is a simulator featuring Newtonian physics and space combat involving fighters and other small craft. Battles take place in planetary orbits and deep space, ranging from small tactical engagements to large-scale fleet battles involving capital ships.

The game has been adapted for modern monitors, with the game engine reworked and the in-game textures improved. Most locations have been redrawn from scratch. Moreover, the developers managed to find sound files that were never used in the original game. This made it possible to rework some missions, make events easier to understand, and add more emotion and color to the future of space.

Story Campaign

The story takes place in space, in the distant future. In Homeplanet, you play as an ordinary pilot from the Troiden clan, one of the many militarized clans of the enclave planet Clouto, in the Capella star system.

A major war erupts on the planet's surface. The small Troiden clan, under attack, is forced to abandon everything and flee the planet's surface. Fighting its way through heavy battles, the clan leaves its homeworld and the Capella system, never to return.

We will find ourselves at the very center of these events. We will cover the clan's evacuation from the planet, fight rearguard actions, escort landing forces, set up ambushes, conduct reconnaissance, and even carry out covert operations under a false flag.

Our pilot will be among the last to leave his home planet.

Newtonian Physics Model

The ships in Homeplanet fly according to the laws of physics. They use engines for acceleration, maneuvering, and braking. The parameters and placement of the engines are realistic and physically accurate, and are visually reflected in the game.

When ships and stations are destroyed, they break apart into debris that can damage other ships. Being killed or suffering serious damage from debris is a common occurrence in Homeplanet combat.

THEY CHOSE THE WRONG GUY AND THEY WILL REGRET IT

Kill aliens, level up your skills, and find your way home. You'll fight on four different planets with unique biomes and procedurally generated environments. The game features three different game modes: Campaign, Endless, and Roguelike.

CLASSES AND WEAPONS

You'll have access to six hero classes and six start primary weapons, reflecting who you were on Earth before your abduction. Each class has distinct stats and a unique special ability, offering a completely different gameplay experience.

THE PARASITE IS INSIDE YOU

You were infected with a parasite that was supposed to control you, but something went wrong and you retained control of your body. Now the parasite gives you access to dozens of different active abilities. Combine ability types and damage types to assemble ultimate builds.

META PROGRESSION

Collect white essence, complete quests, and earn loot by killing ancient aliens to level up your character and challenge the aliens on higher difficulties.

Your homestead is your squad's source of strength. Homestead: Deckbuilding Academy is a single-player strategy game of building with cards, managing residents and exploring new regions. Turn a handful of humble buildings into combinations that help your home and soldiers grow together. Plan your homestead turn by turn; battles unfold automatically in real time.

Turn ruins into cards, and cards into a home

Lead soldiers to clear ruined buildings and bring the reward cards home. Place houses, farms and workshops, then give residents somewhere to live and work. Grow your small foothold into a thriving homestead.

Set off a chain of growth

Start with two buildings that help each other, then combine facilities to multiply output, grant residents extra work and add construction progress to other buildings. Upgrades can trigger further effects. Play a card to complete the combination, advance a turn, and watch work, production and upgrades follow one another.

Build a stronger home. Lead a stronger squad.

Buildings provide soldier ability cards. Equip them, then upgrade their source buildings to strengthen your soldiers. Grow your squad and storm hostile settlements, unleashing skills in real-time automatic battles. After defeating the defenders, clear their buildings for resources and cards.

Trade, acquire settlements and make room to grow

Browse friendly settlement shops, buy useful cards and complete commissions. Meet the acquisition requirements to take over a settlement, gaining residents, building cards and opportunities to expand your homestead. Put that extra space to work on your next combination.

Take your squad farther

Travel through meadows, forests, wetlands and highlands, discovering ruins, shops and settlements. Each region brings new building and ability choices. Bring them home, find a place for them in your layout, and set out again with a stronger squad.

"HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion" is an exploration-focused 3D collection and escape co-op horror game. Avoid sound-sensitive blind monsters, explore the dark rooms throughout the mansion, and escape by collecting hidden mana shards in each room. Cooperate with your teammates to survive until the very end and escape the Blind Mansion.

Mana Crystal :

Mana-infused items are scattered throughout the mansion.
HomunCats must sneak into the Blind Mansion to collect mana crystals.

Blind Monsters:

The monsters in the Blind Mansion are blind, but they are very sensitive to sound.
They instinctively track your heartbeat and attack. If a monster gets close, quickly lie on the floor to hide your heartbeat.
"With loud noise comes great responsibility"


Teammates, and Escape:

As you diligently collect Mana Crystals, you will finally get a chance to escape.

A bigger bonus awaits depending on the timing of your escape, so discuss the escape timing carefully with your teammates.

Of course, keep in mind that your teammates could betray you and escape first at any time.

Interaction:

Every HomunCat can use magic power to mine, absorb, or move distant mana.

Sometimes, you can perform various actions using magic keywords you speak yourself. Activate magic devices, use skills from various classes, or even kick someone!

(It's very dangerous, but you can even kick monsters!)

In addition to this, Blind Mansion is full of numerous contraptions and hidden stories.

Come quickly and join us!

Honest Work is a co-op game about moving cattle from one end of the frontier to the other. That's the whole job. Nobody said it was a good job.

You and your posse have a contract: deliver the herd, get paid, take on a bigger drive. The cattle are dumb, heavy, and easily spooked. The land between here and the delivery pen has rivers, cliffs, predators, rustlers, and weather with a personal grudge.

Your friends have lassos.

DRIVE THE HERD

The cattle are the job, and they don't make it easy. Keep the herd together, push them around danger, chase down stragglers, and get as many as you can to the pen.

Gunshots, predators, terrain, and cowboys charging directly through the middle of the herd can turn an orderly drive into a stampede in seconds.

Whose fault it was is usually pretty obvious.

YOU'LL NEED YOUR POSSE

There's a lot of ground to cover. Someone rides point, someone chases strays, someone keeps wolves off the herd, and someone was supposed to be doing all of that, but is currently being dragged behind another cowboy's horse.

When everything goes wrong at once, proximity voice chat lets you hear exactly how far away help is, and how hard it's laughing.

A COWBOY'S TOOLS

Everything on your saddle does real work.

A revolver for wolves, rustlers, and other frontier disagreements. A lasso for catching cattle, pulling friends out of trouble, and putting those same friends directly back into it - rope a cowboy off their horse and they go wherever your horse goes.

A compass so somebody knows where the pen is. A torch for the night drives. Whiskey for morale.

There's a banjo. It does not help with the cattle.

THE FRONTIER DISAGREES

Wolf packs come off the ridge. Rustlers ride in looking to take what you've got. Buffalo stampedes don't care who's standing in the way. Rivers split the posse, storms turn a bad drive into a worse one, and the longer trails bring tornados, cliff paths, and worse.

And then there's the Winter Pass. Up in the mountains, staying warm is part of the job. Blizzards tear across the trail, warmth drains in the open, and the fires along the route are the difference between moving on and freezing solid where you stand.

BACK IN TOWN

Finish the drive, get paid, and regroup. Buy ammo, patch up, hire a herding dog to work the flank you keep forgetting, try the shooting gallery, and pick out a new hat and the mustache to go under it.

Then saddle up and find out what goes wrong next.

ALSO

  • Online co-op for 1–6 cowboys. Solo works, but there's nobody to blame.

  • Getting shot, trampled, or launched sends your hat flying. Anyone can pick it up. It's their hat now.

  • The dead spectate. The dead cannot give directions. This is a feature.

Drive the cattle. Rope your friends. Get paid.

And remember - you chose these people.

It ain't much, but it's honest work.

The Man Before the Legend

In the winter of 1216 the French army held the English coast, and one county refused to fall. Armed with a bow and attacking from the shadows, historians called him Williken of the Weald.

Story

King John, who has waged war for nearly a decade against the Irish, Welsh, and French, has died of sickness and his soldiers march home for the first time in years. William of Cassingham returns to his modest estate to find it in ruins, his family missing, and the poorfolk suffering. At the heart of it - the corrupt Castellan who rules the county with an iron fist.

The Game

Own the Greenwood: Traverse the county across four biomes (forest, mines, villages, fortresses) in one expansive 2D pixel art map, featuring dynamic weather, time of day, and punishing boss fights.

Hunt in the Dark: You are one man against a garrison, so fight like it. Use stealth and a bow to rain arrows from afar, sneak in for up close kills, or ambush your enemies with environmental traps.

Four Deadly Disciplines: When stealth fails, use the dagger, sword, spear, or flail to launch an all-out assault, including the ability to dodge, parry, and punish. As you inspire hope in the populace and dread in the hearts of your enemies, earn Grace to further expand your skillset with four unique combat skill trees.

Never the Same Woods Twice: Fail in your quest and get an opportunity to try again, featuring full roguelite mechanics with persistent skill progression and procedurally generated enemy locations and tactics each new run.

Hand Drawn, Frame by Frame: Featuring fully animated pixel art characters and world map, enhanced with lush, realistic particle effects and cinematic lighting.

What You Get

  • A 20 hour campaign with six skill trees to master, including martial skills, stamina, and body.

  • One continuous world map featuring 16 areas, 6 epic boss fights, and 4 social hubs.

  • Platforming, stealth, and four weapon disciplines, each with a distinct play style

  • A rich, tragic, and atmospheric story steeped in history - the real man behind the Robin Hood legend.

BUILD YOUR BASKETBALL CAREER.

Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball management game and basketball career simulator focused on your own athlete. Create your player, develop their skills and earn a place in the starting lineup. Player development, match simulation and RPG choices shape your career on and off the court.

Choose where to begin: College, International or Pro. Each path brings a different setting, opportunities and pressure.

DEVELOP YOUR PLAYER

Choose your position, shape your attributes and mentality, then follow your player's development. Performances, consistency, form and injuries affect your minutes and your place in the team. Study your stats and work out where you can make a difference.

Distribute your starting points across technical and physical attributes and see your Overall change as you shape the build. Choose what to work on in training and balance development with recovery. Meet your career rival, compare your progress and stats, and revisit the games you have played against each other.

Your first practice introduces shooting, passing and defensive timing. Read the coach's assessment of each area and the session note in the recap.

FROM THE LOCKER ROOM TO THE FINAL BUZZER

Read the coach's message and make your pregame choices in the locker room. Then follow the action in the Live 2D Match Center, with court movement, play-by-play and game stats, or use quick simulation. After the final buzzer, review the game recap and your player's growth.

During key possessions, make offensive and defensive decisions that influence the action: create a shot, find a teammate or attack the gap. Your choice carries risks; it does not guarantee a basket. Hot & Cold states reflect temporary changes in form driven by performance, visible in the Match Center and quick simulation.

Choose simulation only, tactical choices, or choices with manual input. Story, Intermediate and Hard adjust timing windows for training and for Match Center choices with manual input. On free throws, time both the preparation and the release, then follow the ball to the result.

Fast Sim updates the score, your player's stats and the play-by-play as the game progresses. Its Hot & Cold panel identifies players currently showing those form states.

The Player Growth recap shows your game line alongside season averages, recorded attribute changes and Overall before and after the game. Followers and reputation are tracked separately from technical attributes. Use the suggested next focus to plan what to work on.

MAKE THE CALL OFF THE COURT

Relationships with teammates and coaches, contracts, agents, sponsors and media pressure are part of the career. Look for a bigger role, chase a championship or consider a new team. Your decisions help shape your reputation and where you go next.

Conversations with the coach can unlock the chance to suggest your starting five. Drag teammates into position, review your proposal and send it; the coach makes the final decision. Interactive training, recovery and choices in your life away from the court give you more to consider between games.

Explore the club relationship tree and private conversations with teammates. Away from the court, choose a weekly life plan and read and answer phone messages between career events.

FOLLOW THE BASKETBALL WORLD. LEAVE YOUR MARK.

Basketball carries on beyond your own games. Rosters change, new prospects emerge, veterans retire and the market shifts the balance. Follow teams, schedules, standings and playoffs to see how the season unfolds.

Championships, individual awards, national-team call-ups, records and honors track what you have achieved. Your career is also measured in the seasons you leave behind.

YOUR PLACE IN BASKETBALL

  • A single-player career centered on your own athlete.
  • An original basketball universe with fictional teams and players.
  • Local saves, with no constant internet connection required.

Horde Up Ahead is a tower defense roguelite about holding your ground against increasingly massive zombie hordes.

You are trapped in a central tower with nowhere to run. Take aim and fight back with your own weapon, then build automated turrets around the tower to turn the battlefield into a wall of fire.

Place AR, Shotgun, Sniper, and M249 turrets, choose where they face, and build a defense capable of handling ever-growing swarms. Spend the Gold you earn during a run to upgrade your turrets and increase their firepower as the pressure rises.

But every run is only part of the battle.

Use permanent resources between runs to unlock and improve upgrades in the Merchant, strengthen your defenses, and prepare for larger hordes. Progress further, grow stronger, and push the numbers higher.

DEFEND THE TOWER

The tower is your last line of defense. Zombies can approach from different directions, forcing you to build around the threats you face.

FIGHT BACK YOURSELF

Your turrets are not your only weapons. Aim and shoot zombies manually when your defenses need extra help.

BUILD YOUR FIREPOWER

Deploy different turret types with their own strengths, ranges, fire rates, and roles. Position them carefully and let them automatically tear into the horde.

UPGRADE DURING THE RUN

Collect Gold from fallen enemies and spend it on turret upgrades while the battle is still going.

GROW STRONGER BETWEEN RUNS

Invest permanent resources in the Merchant and build long-term progression across multiple upgrade branches.

FACE BIGGER AND BIGGER HORDES

What begins as a manageable attack can grow into thousands of zombies pressing toward the tower at once.

Build. Upgrade. Shoot. Survive.

There is a Horde Up Ahead.

Command the office floor as an embattled CEO in a satirical top-down action tower defense. Hire employee towers, build offices, and fight off waves of disgruntled enemy employees each fiscal quarter. Then survive the hostile takeover that decides your fate!

Now Hiring: Chief Executive Officer

MegaCorp Holdings LLC is pleased to announce an exciting leadership opportunity for a results-driven executive with a passion for resource allocation, crisis management, and personally surviving the consequences of their own company policy.

Hostile Takeover, Inc. is corporate "leadership" at its most predatory and least competent. And you're holding the wheel.

Prior experience not required. Prior ethics strongly discouraged.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fight on the office floor in person against 18 unique and varied enemy types, as they attempt to resolve themselves against your hit points.

  • Choose amongst 7 different executives to play as, each with their own unique charm and detriments.

  • Hire from 15 specialized employee towers, including Interns, Engineers, Lawyers, Consultants, Recruiters, Headhunters, and other legally distinct workplace hazards.

  • Manage capital, salaries, promotions, terminations, and the occasional company-wide strike caused by your own payroll decisions.

  • Build offices across five departments to unlock company-wide buffs, grow your Golden Parachute reserves, and paint larger targets on company property.

  • Enjoy Infinite Profits, an endless survival mode allowing the use of absurd gameplay modifiers.

  • Survive encounters from 4 challenging bosses, then choose powerful Board Packet initiatives that may or may not be blessings in disguise.

  • Trigger the final hostile takeover, where three brutal waves attack from concentrated fronts and your surviving offices decide your payout.

Executive Authority

Your CEO is not just a cursor in a suit. Your aura of micromanagement damages enemies, collects loot, and buffs nearby towers, forcing you to choose between safe movement and front-line supervision.

Every tower costs capital. Every promotion increases payroll. Every office makes you stronger, richer, and more vulnerable. If your capital drops below zero, your towers go on strike, because even in a satire game, employees demand a steady paycheck.

Compensation & Benefits

MegaCorp offers a competitive Golden Parachute package, payable in proportion to your ability to avoid Chapter 11 Bankruptcy.

Benefits include:

  • Performance-based capital acquisition.

  • Premium corner offices.

  • 36 professional development opportunities, disguised as level-up choices.

  • Board-approved fiscal-year difficulty escalations.

  • A hostile work environment in the most literal possible sense.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Able to convert panic into policy.

  • Familiarity with tower defense, survivor-like action, and pretending that layoffs are strategy.

  • Willingness to hover uncomfortably close to your employees until they become measurably more productive.

  • Ability to maintain shareholder confidence while everything around you catches fire.

Equal Opportunity Statement

MegaCorp Holdings LLC is an equal opportunity employer, in the sense that all applicants will be equally blamed for systemic failure.

Apply today!

Your desk is ready.

Your employees are not.

A normal night at the hotel reception changes with a phone call from Room 138. The woman on the other end says something is wrong and asks you to come upstairs.

There may not be an anomaly on every floor.

If there is an anomaly, turn back.

If there is no anomaly, keep going.

Even a small change may be enough to help you make the right decision.

An anomaly-based psychological horror game set in the repeating corridors of a hotel, inspired by liminal spaces and unsettling environments.

You have been invited to the mysterious Hotel Carnivalia.

Predator or Prey

Leave your old life behind. In Hotel Carnivalia you will be given one of 26 roles. Become a predator and hunt the weak, or become prey and run, hide, and root out the ones hunting you.

Explore the Hotel

Nothing in Hotel Carnivalia is decided with a single button. Walk to your victim's room and take them down with a gun or a blade. Then follow the traces left behind to find out who the predators are.

Anyone Can Become a Victim

When a predator draws a knife and comes for you, get behind them first. Every role can wound and kill every other role. In this place, the only one you can trust is yourself.

The Hotel Isn't Open Yet

In Hotel Carnivalia, 4 to 15 players lie to, hunt, and track each other. You can start with just 4 players. That is not something a development team can build on its own. It takes real players. Join our development playtests and tell us what you think about role balance, the layout of the hotel, and new rules. Your feedback goes into the next build. You can find our Discord in the links on this page, and the test schedule is posted there.

Streaming and Videos Are Welcome

We welcome gameplay streams and videos of Hotel Carnivalia, and you may monetize them. We'd appreciate it if you included the game name in your stream or video title and the Steam store link in the description. Even better, drop by our Discord and share a link to your stream or video. We'd love to watch you play!

Nana taught you the game. You make the rules.

Pull up a chair for House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike, where classic dominoes meets rule-bending perks and a little family rivalry.

Bend the rules

Change a domino’s pips, swap tiles, and turn blanks into wildcards.

Build powerful combos

Draft perks and stack their bonuses to make every scoring play hit harder.

Grow your game

Unlock new perks and upgrade your skill tree as you play.

Play solo or online

Outsmart computer rivals or challenge another player across the table.

Solve puzzles

Make every move count in 20 solo challenges. No opponent. No timer.

Make the table yours

Unlock avatars, domino skins, tables, and music.

Me:

I came to Earth to study humans, and I noticed a strange ritual involving groups of them standing inside a vertically moving metal box. They call it an elevator.

Once inside, they mostly avoid eye contact. Research suggests that making eye contact in an elevator causes an increase in human heart rate, which may eventually lead to death.

Isn’t that weird?

Adults:

The standard human model. They are pretty tall, though, especially by our standards. Perhaps the atmosphere at that elevation is more suitable for their respiratory systems. 

Kids:

Humans produce smaller versions of themselves that eventually grow up and replace them.

Perhaps this is necessary because human life science still hasn’t figured out eternal life.

Luggage:

Humans still haven’t invented space-compression technology, so the space inside their luggage is exactly as large as it appears from the outside.

They just in the way. What's even the point?

Couples:

Perhaps some form of conjoined twins.

They seem unable to separate from each other, even for a few seconds, and insist on staying together wherever they go.

Very difficult to deal with.

HueTrix — Stack the Colors. Break the Board. Get Stronger.

HueTrix is a colorful block-stacking puzzle with a roguelike economy. Clear lines to earn cash, spend it in the shop on powerful mythic relics, and build a game-breaking run that grows stronger every round.

🎨 Seven Colors, Seven Effects

Every color carries its own effect. Group matching colors and clear them in chains to send your earnings soaring — the longer the combo, the bigger the payout.

💰 Earn, Shop, Strategize

Each round, clearing lines fills your wallet. Spend it in the shop to shape your strategy with mythic relics like Hephaestus's Hammer, the Rainbow Crown, and the Rainbow Covenant — game-changing artifacts that turn the board in your favor.

🔁 Endless Build Variety

Which colors do you invest in? Which relics do you combine? Every run plays out differently. Easy to pick up, deep to master.

🎮 Comfortable to Play

Full support for keyboard and Xbox / PlayStation controllers. Your progress syncs automatically through Steam Cloud, and Steam Achievements keep you chasing that next milestone.

HOW LONG WILL YOUR HULL LAST?

HULLSTORM is a space survival shooter where you’ll fight through increasingly aggressive waves of enemies. Aim, fire, boost your ship, and collect as much XP as possible before the enemy fleet turns the arena into hell.

The mission? Survive.
The plan? Become absurdly overpowered.

CREATE A DEVASTATING BUILD

Destroy enemies, collect XP, and choose a new upgrade whenever you level up. Reinforce your hull, increase your firepower, deploy support units, or transform your weapons with evolutions that can completely change the run.

Overheated beams, minefields, plasma, missiles, defenses, companions… Combine them all and discover just how far your build can go.

CHOOSE YOUR SHIP

Pilot eight different hulls, each with its own stats, traits, and playstyle. Unlock them, master their strengths, increase their mastery level, and earn new finishes for your fleet.

There is no perfect ship. Only the one that gets you out alive.

EXTRACT… OR MAKE THE MISTAKE OF STAYING

Survive the 25 waves of Siege and defeat five bosses with unique phases and attack patterns. Then you can extract with a reward bonus and celebrate your victory…

…or stay behind and enter Endless, where enemies continue to grow in number, durability, and power.

Surely one more wave won’t hurt.

CHANGE THE RULES OF BATTLE

  • 5 game modes

  • 3 difficulty levels

  • 8 playable hulls

  • 6 weapon families

  • 6 build evolutions

  • 5 multi-phase bosses

  • 37 achievements and 12 challenges

  • Workshop, mastery, codex, and persistent progression

Every defeat sends you back to the hangar with more scrap, more options, and another terrible idea for your next build.

The storm never stops. You decide when to stop.

Hold the door until dawn

Night falls over Hollowmere, and Varkolak wakes up hungry. Every player claims a haven of their own: a small walled shelter with a bed, a door and room to build. Sleep to earn gold, chop wood to repair, raise towers… and survive until the sun burns the vampire to ash.

A vampire that hunts you

Varkolak is not a wave of monsters: he is a hunter. His Eye of Hunger picks a haven, his hordes rise far away and march in, and every bite makes him stronger. Get caught and you end up in the Blood Cage, unless your friends come to break you out.

Build, upgrade, survive

  • Six towers that turn to face the enemy: arrows, a heavy crossbow, a fire brazier, a ballista, a holy bell, and a silver cannon made for the vampire.
  • Turn a wooden palisade into stone, iron, silver and blessed marble. A stronger haven also earns more gold.
  • A sawmill, a workbench, a chapel, lanterns, and a market to trade and send resources to your friends.
  • Built in the wrong spot? Demolish it and get your resources back.

Roguelite upgrades at every level

Level up and choose one of three upgrade cards: faster repairs, deeper pockets, a heavier swing, gold while you sleep… Stack them and build a different hero every night.

Four heroes, one team

Bram the Carpenter, Wren the Hunter, Sister Agnes and Pip the Lamplighter, each with a skill and an ultimate of their own. Play solo with bots, or online with up to 7 friends and voice chat.

The Nights of Hollowmere

A ladder of nights, each harder than the last, on procedural maps: early wolves, swarms of ghouls, double hordes, and the Lord himself. Every night you beat unlocks new towers, buildings and cards.

Features

  • Online co-op for 1–8 players, with Steam lobbies, a region filter and ping. Bots fill any empty seat.
  • One haven per player. When yours falls, a friend can take you in.
  • Procedural maps that grow with the number of players.
  • Built-in voice chat with push-to-talk.
  • Hand-drawn gothic cartoon art and a spooky original soundtrack.
  • Fully playable in 13 languages.

A tribute to the classic game NS-SHAFT, which inspired this project. My deepest respect goes to its developers!

Hundredfold: Hero’s Ascent tells a simple, old-fashioned hero’s tale.

A swindler in a tavern tells our hero that an unknown treasure lies at the bottom of a hundred-floor dungeon. Everyone warns him that the dungeon is deadly, but he has only one question:

What is waiting on the hundredth floor?

This is an action platformer about descending deeper and deeper. Dodge enemy attacks, avoid deadly traps, and use special combat platforms to fight back.

Across one hundred floors, you will face different enemies with their own appearances, attack patterns, and special abilities.

Don’t worry—you won’t be going in empty-handed. Equipment, a forge, a rune workshop, and other facilities are available to help you prepare for the journey.

Travel through five distinct regions, from the dungeon entrance to the depths of the abyss. Every region introduces new enemies, mechanics, and challenges.

What really lies on the hundredth floor?

Give it everything you have, hero. Reach the bottom and uncover the secret.

Game Features

⚔️ A straightforward adventure inspired by classic platformers, now with combat.

🎮 Simple controls and one clear objective: defeat the monsters and keep descending.

👾 A steadily increasing challenge, with new mechanics and surprises appearing throughout the journey.

👍 Several progression systems outside the dungeon—but none of them are mandatory. If you’re good enough, you can even take off your equipment.

🔮 No small fry—only serious opponents! Each of the one hundred monsters has its own characteristics.

🚀 Every area features specially designed platforms, enemy attacks, and stage mechanics spread across its floors.

Ideas Still Being Considered

⛰️ How can the relic system become even more interesting?

♾️ Should an endless mode unlock after completing the game?

Let me know what you think! I’ll be working hard to get a playable demo into your hands as soon as possible.

about_html:
In Hunted Within: Terminal Rust, you traverse a harsh wasteland consumed by blinding sandstorms,

deadly gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors.

Armed with makeshift rusty industrial weaponry and your trusty dual-detection terminal,

Pilot your own survival train through the desolate desert and pitch-black caverns, and abandoned areas.

Monitor your terminal for environmental threats, conserve your momentum, and fight back against

relentless mutations to survive.

THE STORY

In this chapter of Hunted Within, your hunt for your ultimate nemesis continues.

The Psycho Doctor has executed all of his test subjects -except you- and unleashed a catastrophic bio-virus

onto your final remaining companion in the Metro.

The MISSION

Your mission is simple: track the psycho doctor down across the desolate surface and put a permanent end

to his nightmare experiments.

KEY FEATURES

  • The Survival train: it's your mobile base, your refuge, and your key to reaching new areas,

  • The Dual-Detector Terminal: Keep your terminal scanner close. Track invisible, crushing gravitational field anomalies and incoming sandstorms in real time to navigate safely through lethal terrain.

  • Rust-Tech Warfare: Wield and upgrade heavy, makeshift industrial weaponry—from high-torque saw-blade melee weapons to devastating triple-barrel, break-action shotguns.

  • Adaptive Biomechanical Horrors: Face blind photosensitive stalkers, mutated titans, burrowing scorpions, and savage cavern dwellers and more creepy and deadly experiment subjects.

Hunters Origin invites you to carve your own legend in the Northern Lands

Explore a living online world filled with dangerous hunts, hidden secrets, powerful loot, and a town worth coming home to in Hunters Origin. This action-packed RPG offers plenty of depth and complexity along with exciting combat and progression.

Follow the main story in the Northern Lands or shape your own path by taking on hundreds of side quests. Your choices can unlock new paths, restore forgotten places, and help shape Archer's Pond.

OK, but what is Archer’s Pond?

This is your main base, your quest hub, your place to go back to and rest. It’s also where you meet other players. Forge gear, trade resources, swap stories at the tavern, show off your mount, spend time with friends. Archer's Pond is a place to prepare for adventure and a place to return to when the hunt is over.

When you’re ready go out there and hunt!

With what though?

You first pick one of six starting classes that you are then free to evolve into something uniquely yours. Experiment with a deep skill tree, class evolution, powerful item sets, and more than 1,000 items. Fine-tune your stats, combine talents and gear, exploit elemental weaknesses, and adapt your build to every challenge.

And what are we fighting for?

For loot, obviously! After defeating your enemies, find powerful gear with unique bonuses and distinctive looks. Complete item sets, collect rare mounts, and ride into danger on everything from saber-toothed cats to massive war mammoths. After all, what's the point of legendary loot if nobody gets to see it?

Gather materials, craft equipment, brew potions, trade with others, and contribute to the growth of the world around you. Progress doesn't stop when combat ends - crafting and resource management are part of the journey.

Come join us now!

One position. One breath. One shot.

Hunters Trial: One Breath is a fixed-position, scope-only hunting game built around stillness and timing. You never walk and you never chase. Rooted to a single vantage point, you pan across the wild, read each animal, hold your breath to steady the crosshair, and squeeze off one clean shot at the perfect moment.

Heart, lungs, liver: every hit is scored by where it actually lands, and clean shots pay the most.

Real ballistics: bullets travel and drop, so at long range you read the distance and hold over.

X-ray shot replays follow the bullet through the body, so you see exactly why a shot was clean.

Hold your breath to steady the scope, and trigger slow motion to thread a shot through a bolting herd.

Deer, boar, wolves, eagles, lions, giraffes, elephants and more.

Passive animals graze and flee when startled, while predators charge straight at you. Drop them before they reach you.

120 levels across 12 acts: grasslands, forests, deserts, canyons and mountain peaks.

Weather and conditions change visibility on every hunt, from first light to fog and dusk.

More ways to hunt: Endless waves, a Daily hunt that's the same for everyone, Gauntlet runs (ten waves, a new species in each, three strikes and you're out) and Clay shooting with the Field Pump 12.

Chain clean hits into streaks, earn medals and 3-star ratings, and complete weekly contracts at the lodge.

Unlock 8 scoped rifles and spend XP on hunter upgrades all the way to Master Hunter. 39 Steam Achievements to hunt down.

At a glance

  • Genre: arcade hunting / fixed-position marksman

  • Single-player

  • Playable with mouse and keyboard or a controller

  • Guided tutorial and photo mode included

  • No story mode, no co-op, no online. Just you, your breath, and the shot you were waiting for.

Just you, your breath, and the shot you were waiting for.

Join the community: news, patch notes and a direct line to the developer on our Discord server. Find the link in the sidebar.

Hunting Contract is an online co-op horror game for 1–4 players with proximity voice chat, ragdoll physics and monsters that hit back. Sign a contract with Cerberus, hunt what stalks Blackwood Estate and bring the body home in a coffin. Dead or alive, the quota still has to be met.



Werewolves don't read contracts.
Track your target across the estate, find the guns hidden in the house and make every shot count. Miss, and you're the one being hunted.



The kill is only half the job.
Seal the body in a coffin and carry it to the truck as a team. It's heavy. It's slow. Something is watching.



Everything in the mansion is for sale.
Grab the valuables on your way out, but watch the cellar gnomes. They steal loot [COMPANY PROPERTY] and won't give it back without a fight.



Your friends are your only backup. And your biggest problem.
Talk through proximity voice chat and radios, carry the fallen to safety, revive them with a needle—or slap them across the room. Wendigos love a hunter who wanders off alone.



Cerberus thanks you for your sacrifice [SERVICE].
Every three nights, Cerberus sets a quota. Contract rewards and the loot you drag out count toward it, and the shop never takes it back. Make it and the next one is bigger. Miss it and the whole crew is fired. Sign the next contract?


Cerberus is not responsible for lost limbs, lost loot or lost friends.

Enter the wilderness
Either on foot or behind the wheel of your all-terrain vehicle, explore this open world's stunning environments.

Set off to deepest Colorado, or untamed outback of Texas, each with dozens of wild species to hunt. In these ever-changing ecosystems, each animal reacts to what you do, ages over time, and exhibits true-to-life behaviour thanks to our unique “SimFauna” system.

Hunt your own way
Kit yourself out with one of the official weapons and other items , to hunt the way you want. Choose from a professional hunting arsenal, comprising rifles, shotguns, bows and crossbows. Take your pick from the best hunting brands like, Remington, Beretta, Winchester, Browning and many more.

A hunter's best friend
To help you in your hunt, you can rely on your faithful hunting dog. With its keen senses, it helps you better understand your surroundings and allows you to spot tracks, follow a trail, or retrieve small game.
Use the command wheel to make it respond to all your orders.

A warm, practical hunting lodge
Feel like a bit of peace and quiet, admiring your arsenal or honing your shooting skills?

Take advantage of your customisable hunting lodge to showcase your finest trophies, purchase or modify your gear, or simply relax by the fire before your next hunt.
Test yourself in an intense clay-pigeon shoot. Armed with your favourite weapon, knock down the targets within the allotted time to score maximum points, and try to reach the top of the leaderboard!

BLAME IT ON THE TEQUILA

Have you ever had an absurd dream and believed it was all real? Well, that’s exactly what happened to this group of partygoers after a wild Day of the Dead celebration. They found themselves trapped in a shared nightmare where the piñata got tired of taking a beating, so it put on a blindfold and chased them all night long!

SOUND GIVES YOU AWAY; SILENCE SEALS YOUR FATE...

The piñata hunts the partygoers by sound! Every little noise you make turns into colorful echoes that reveal your location.

Going to eat some candy? It will hear every bite. Decide not to eat? Your stomach will growl with hunger and give away your hiding spot. Try to run away? It will hear every single step you take.

And believe me... standing still might be the worst decision you could make!

WEAR THE BLINDFOLD

In Hush Piñata, you can also take on the role of the piñata! And your mission is simple: turn the partygoers' nightmare into something even worse!

During the match, golden cubes will appear across the map, bringing new surprises to make your hunt even more fun... at least for you!

Collecting one of these cubes grants you a random weapon, each with unique abilities and perks to help you take down the partygoers.

THE TASK AT HAND...

The partygoers' main mission is simple: rip off the piñata's tail! But there's a slight problem... at the start of the match, it's locked tight and can't be torn off!

To unlock it, the partygoers must complete a series of tasks scattered across the map. It sounds easy, but the catch is that each task is noisier than the last, and any noise might attract the piñata's attention!

THE COWARD'S ARSENAL

For every task completed, you earn a ticket to use at the item stall! There, you'll find a variety of surprises to make your mission easier... or turn the other partygoers' nightmare into something even worse!

 

THE GOAT

This goat can sniff out any partygoer carrying a piece of candy in their pocket! If it catches the scent, watch out! He’ll chase you across the map, bleating non-stop and making enough noise to draw the piñata's attention!

The only way to keep him quiet is to offer up one of your precious candies.

But the choice is yours... give the goat a treat, or risk being found by the piñata?

RIP OFF THE TAIL.

If, by some miracle, you’re still alive after all that, having completed every task and escaped the piñata, congratulations! But don't celebrate just yet... because the hardest part is only just beginning!

Now you need to work up the courage to get close to the piñata and rip off its tail!

Sound impossible? Hold on, it gets even worse!

Once you’ve ripped off the tail, you’ll have to run for your life while holding onto it until the counter hits 100%. And watch out! Other partygoers might try to steal it from you, too!

If your strategy works and you pull off this feat, get ready for the grand finale: the piñata EXPLODES in a shower of candy!

All those treats will be converted into coins you can spend in the lobby's skin shop to unlock new looks for your characters.

DYING ISN'T THE END OF THE MATCH

Did you die? Don't worry, your nightmare isn't over yet!

How you die depends on the game mode. In "Steal the Piñata's Tail," you get a second chance to return to the land of the living. Just take an offering to the altar and perform the ritual to resurrect!

But here's a tip: never die empty-handed!

If you forget to secure an offering before you die, you'll have to wander the map as a ghost, haunting other partygoers and trying to convince them to make an offering on your behalf!

In "Last Survivor" mode, death is final... but that doesn't mean you have to sit back and watch everyone else have fun!

Upon dying, you can take control of La Catrina and explore the land of the dead, searching for the bodies of other partygoers who met an unpleasant end.

Your new mission is to collect these bodies and earn coins as a reward, coins you can spend at the lobby skin shop!

This mechanic ensures no one misses out on the fun. Even after being eliminated, you stay involved in the match by exploring, completing a new mission, and racking up rewards while waiting to see who wins it all.

THREE MODES

STEAL THE PIÑATA'S TAIL: the main mode. Up to 8 Partygoers versus 1 blindfolded Piñata. Tasks, tickets, tail, burst, you already know this mode.

LAST ONE STANDING: no tail, no tasks, and no clock. Just survival. The last Partygoer alive wins and takes all the coins, which means the Partygoer next to you also wants you to make noise.

TEAM VS. TEAM: Green vs. Red, from 2v2 to 4v4, with the Piñata controlled by the game. The team that ends up holding the tail wins, best of three.

AND BETWEEN MATCHES

The coins you collect can be spent in the lobby shop to buy characters, hairstyles, hats, mustaches, outfits, and various accessories.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW BEFORE BUYING THE GAME

For the best experience, use headphones! Sound is a crucial part of Hush Piñata, and hearing where noises are coming from can make all the difference.

Using a microphone is also very important, as the Piñata can hear your voice and figure out where you are. But don't worry, you can also play with the microphone turned off.

You can play online with up to 9 players by creating a private room with a code for your friends or by joining one of the available public rooms.

Matches are quick, and players can take turns playing as the Piñata.

A free-for-all space arena where every move you make leaves a permanent trail behind your ship. As the match progresses, the arena fills up with walls of light — yours and your opponents' — until there's nowhere left to hide. One touch and you're out. Last ship standing wins the round.

CORE GAMEPLAY Your ship moves forward at all times — you control the direction. Every second you're alive, your trail grows, cutting off paths for everyone including yourself. Collide with any trail, any wall, or another ship, and you're eliminated instantly. Use your boost to burst through tight gaps when the arena gets too crowded, but manage your charge carefully — it won't last forever.

MULTIPLAYER & SOLO Play online in free-for-all matches with 2 to 8 players, or practice solo against bots. Mix humans and bots in the same match to fill empty slots. Host a public match for anyone to join, or create a private one for your group.

HOST-CONFIGURABLE MATCHES The host controls the rules. Adjust the number of rounds (1–15), arena size (Small, Medium, Large), ship speed (Slow, Normal, Fast), and max player count. Every setting changes how the game feels — a small arena at high speed is a completely different experience from a large one at normal pace.

ROUNDS & SCORING Each match is made up of multiple rounds. Win a round by being the last ship alive and earn a victory point. At the end of all rounds, the player with the most points wins the match. Between rounds, the arena resets and all ships respawn for a fresh start.

20 SHIPS TO UNLOCK Start with 3 default ships and unlock 17 more by completing Steam achievements — win your first PvP match, reach a win streak, survive hundreds of rounds, win on every arena size, and more. All ships are purely cosmetic with unique designs but no gameplay advantage.

STATS, ACHIEVEMENTS & LEADERBOARDS Track your PvP wins, matches played, win rate, best win streak, and rounds survived. Climb the Steam leaderboard ranked by PvP rounds won. Compete for achievement milestones that unlock new ships as you progress.

NEON AESTHETIC & SYNTHWAVE AUDIO Neon light trails, and ships that pulse with color. A synthwave soundtrack sets the tone, with dynamic audio that shifts between menu and gameplay. Every explosion, every boost, every countdown beep is designed to keep the tension high.

WELCOME! NOW GET TO WORK

You've hated trees with a passion all your life. At last, fate is doing you a favour: your life's calling can now bring you both genuine joy and cold, hard cash! All thanks to a mysterious employer who's suspiciously wary of anything pointy.

UNRAVEL MYSTERIES AND HELP THE LOCAL ODDBALLS

An ISLAND awaits — full of mysteries, secrets, eccentric locals (and their utterly unhinged requests), and TREES just begging to be chopped down, uprooted and turned into money.

AUTOMATE — AND DON'T ANGER YOUR DEFINITELY-NOT-A-VAMPIRE EMPLOYER

Chop! Burn! Hire workers! Automate! The island is enormous, and you can't do it all alone.

Unlock new skills, buy and upgrade tools, and become more EFFICIENT at destroying trees! Whether it's nature or magic, this place has plants from all over the world. A plain old axe won't cut it.

Just don't forget who's really in charge here...

AND MOST IMPORTANTLY... FLOWERS ARE TREES. ROCKS ARE TREES TOO. EVERYTHING IS TREES.

Your employer has completely lost the plot, so... flowers count as trees! Rocks too... and apparently even crabs... What else? What's he hiding? And why do you hate trees so much?

FEATURES

  • Chop, burn and uproot TREES. Flowers and rocks count too — take it up with your employer.

  • Hurl your axe with a mighty swing and call it back to your hand. Walking over to fetch it is inefficient!

  • Buy and upgrade tools: the local flora has far too many chances of survival.

  • Hire workers and collector bots — let someone else's hard work make you money.

  • Unlock skills and turn your hatred of trees into a profitable business.

  • Explore the island, uncover secrets and fulfil the local oddballs' unhinged requests.

  • Get a dog. You can pet it. Please don't chop it.

  • Find out what your definitely-not-a-vampire employer is hiding.

Hack and slash, tower defense, roguelite, incremental, idle: all moved by one mouse.
  • Hack and slash: your cursor is the blade. Every monster it passes through is cut.
  • Tower defense: wave after wave comes for the crystal at the center. Hold it to the end.
  • Roguelite: each run deals two weapons beside the one in hand and a fresh draft of awakening cards, and what you keep sends the next run further.
  • Incremental: shards raise the forge, a melt pays embers for relics, and every number keeps climbing.
  • Idle: switch on IDLE and the blade, the skills, the signs and the card picks run themselves.

Twenty themes


Twenty places to push through, wave by wave, each with its own monsters. Before a run, the themes page weighs your DPS against what the place needs and shows what it pays.

Level cards


Three picks a level: cut the pack open with the blade and take one card of three, or open ten at once.

Every level pays


Each level pays a skill point for the tree and, from level 40, points for your awakening stats. Between runs, set your starting hand: up to sixteen cards every run opens with, a slot for each boss you beat in the first four themes.

Pacts


Seal pacts to make a run harder for more shards and embers: a shorter clock, a crystal of glass, three more elites every wave.

A skin for every theme


Clear a theme's wave 40 and its skin is yours: every page, the cursor and the crystal in that theme's light. Wear it whole, or one part at a time.

What resets, what stays

Progress builds in three layers: one starts over every run, one at every melt, and one never.

Each run starts fresh. You draft awakening cards from scratch again, one from three at a time, up to ninety-nine in a run, and the weapons that come into the two empty sockets climb from LV 1 again. When the crystal breaks, your hand of cards is gone, but nothing you picked up is lost: shards go to the bank, gear to your bag, and the experience is already yours, so even a run that broke early leaves you stronger.

Each melt starts the forge over. Between runs your banked shards buy upgrades along the forge's seven rows and raise the sword's tier from Chipped Iron to Godsteel; when the climb slows, melt the sword. Its tier goes back to one and the forge and the bank empty, but the melt pays embers: the further your runs reached and the higher the sword stood, the more. Embers buy relics rank by rank, and the ranks stay. Right after a melt, before your next run or forge purchase, you may also hand relics back for every ember they cost and spend them another way.

Everything else is yours for good. No melt takes:
  • your level, and every skill point it paid
  • your skill tree: 28 nodes holding nine player skills
  • your signs, five shapes drawn with the blade
  • your level cards, sixty in all: three picks every level, and each card you pick again climbs a rank, up to rank 30
  • your relics, and every rank you bought
  • your gear: sixteen slots, seven rarities, eighteen uniques
  • every weapon you have won, thirty-nine beside the sword
  • every theme you have opened, twenty in all

So a melt is never a loss: it trades the sword's tier for relics that never leave, the next climb is faster than the last, and what stays only grows with every run.
