WELCOME GUESTS. SHAPE THE ISLAND. BREAK THE CYCLE

You didn't plan on owning an island.

But after an unexpected auction leaves you responsible for a neglected little place somewhere in the Mediterranean, that's exactly where you end up.

I'LL KEEP IT is a first-person hospitality and island management game about taking care of a place that has been left behind. One guest, one repair and one day at a time.

Guests arrive by seaplane with their own plans, expectations and personalities. It is up to you to prepare the island for them, decide what needs your attention and keep everything running throughout the day.

Take care of the island

There is always something that could use your attention.

Clean up neglected spaces, repair broken objects, restock supplies, serve guests and gradually bring cafés, shops, paths and other parts of the island back to life.

You decide what is worth fixing first and how much care you want to put into the little things.

Welcome different guests

Visitors arrive and spend their day exploring the island.

Prepare the places they want to visit, keep an eye on what they need and decide how to organize your time before they move on.

You won't always be able to do everything.

What you choose to take care of (and what you leave for another day) shapes their experience.

Plan your day

Use your planner to keep track of visiting groups, their routes and the places they intend to spend time at.

A day moves from morning through evening, turning every visit into a small management puzzle: what should you prepare now, what can wait, and where will you be needed next?

Make progress that stays

Your work doesn't disappear when the day ends.

Restore neglected locations, improve the island, unlock new possibilities and slowly turn a place that has been deteriorating for years into something that feels alive again.

Some changes are practical.

Others are simply there because you cared enough to make them.

Discover what happened here

The island has a history. And not everything about it is immediately explained.

Meet the people connected to the place, explore its forgotten corners and uncover more of its story as your relationship with the island grows.

What begins as an unusual purchase gradually becomes something much more personal.

Your island doesn't need to be perfect.

It just needs someone willing to KEEP IT.

I Spy is a multiplayer social deduction game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to hunt your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer. Read suspicious behaviour, stay hidden, and outsmart your opponents to survive.
Combine different elimination styles and stealth strategies to climb the leaderboard.

Disappear in Plain Sight

Phone booths. Hidden passages. Narrow streets.
Break line of sight. Lose your hunter. Re-enter the city unseen.

Select your operator and go undercover

Pick your spy, then load them with the perks that best suit your mission.

Unconventional Strategies

Try planting a booby trap to lure your target. How about putting on a disguise to throw off your pursuer... or transform other bystanders into you?

You’re Not Alone in the City

Others are hunting.
And being hunted.

Stay alert. Every move matters.

What This Experience Is Not

  • Not a fast-paced arcade shooter
    Even with respawns, matches aren’t about constant action. Timing, positioning, and patience matter as much as reflexes.

  • Not a pure deathmatch
    Eliminations are only part of the objective. Tracking, evading, and deceiving other players are just as important.

  • Not an open-world city
    The city is dense and handcrafted for tension, not scale. Every street, passage, and interior exists for player interaction.

  • Not a progression-only experience
    Progression and leveling support different playstyles, but awareness and decision-making always come first.

What This Is

  • A hunt-and-deceive multiplayer game
    Every player is both hunter and prey, constantly switching roles as the match unfolds.

  • A living city designed for mind games
    The streets, crowds, and shortcuts of Eryl Markt are tools — not scenery.

  • Social stealth with intent
    Blend with NPCs, fake routines, and use player behavior to stay unnoticed.

  • Competitive, but readable
    Six players, clear objectives, and room for strategy — without overwhelming complexity.

Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening.

IAI//BREAKER is a bullet-hell swordfighting action game where iaido slashes send enemy bullets flying back. Wield your blade with the mouse and face ten formidable foes.

Press the attack or hold your ground?

Deflect incoming bullets to recover energy, or sheathe your blade and strike with a sweeping draw slash. With limited energy, every counterattack is a choice.

Turn danger into a counterstrike.

Use Focus to slow the bullets and read their paths. Even an attack that breaks through ordinary defense can become a powerful counter when caught at the center of your blade.

Read. Break. Overcome.

Wear down your foe with returned bullets, then follow up when their guard breaks. Learn each opponent’s patterns and timing, and master the decisive strike.



Choose your challenge across three difficulty levels.

▸ An AI That Lives and Breathes Inside Your PC IDEA: 20Q is a game where you play Twenty Questions against an artificial intelligence that runs entirely on your computer. Every word you think of, every question you ask — none of it ever leaves your device.

▸ More Than Just Twenty Questions Your opponent isn't working from a script. It's an AI that actually reasons. To guess your word, it narrows down possibilities question by question. When you're the one asking, it answers based on facts and logic.

▸ Three Ways to Play

  • I'll Guess — The AI picks a word. Figure it out in 20 yes-or-no questions.

  • I'll Answer — You pick the word. The AI tries to deduce it. Don't let it win.

  • Co-op — An AI partner suggests questions and works alongside you toward the answer.

▸ Two Characters Ganymede, a dimension-watcher driven by curiosity. Europa, a recorder of human civilization. Through every game you play, these two beings work to understand what it means to be human.

▸ Multiple Endings Why are you playing Twenty Questions with them? Beyond the light-hearted deduction game, a quietly unfolding science fiction story is waiting for you.

▸ More to Discover

  • 12-chapter campaign (in development)

  • Puzzle minigames

  • Post-game AI review — the AI replays your questions and scores your reasoning

  • Undo, hints, difficulty settings, and a personal game history archive

  • Korean & English supported

Who's the strongest in history?

Napoleon? Miyamoto Musashi? The First Emperor of Qin? No backstory needed — Napoleon lines up his cannons, Musashi draws his twin blades, and the First Emperor raises the Terracotta Army. The moment you see the name, you know how they fight. Pick one legend, mow down the oncoming hordes, and survive the battlefield! You only move — attacks are automatic. Anyone can be fighting within a minute.

Legends become weapons

Every legend has a signature weapon. Level up, choose upgrades, and raise that weapon until it evolves into a form shaped by its owner's legend. Who you pick changes how you fight; what you pick changes your build — the same legend plays differently every run.

Real history rewrites the battlefield

Battlefields are more than backdrops. At Austerlitz the ice underfoot is slick. At Sekigahara the fog swallows your sight. At Julu, shattered terracotta soldiers rise as enemies. At Thermopylae, cliffs squeeze the horde into a narrow pass. And on a battlefield tied to a legend, you can recruit that legend — every new battlefield is a door to a new hero.

Survive history, four players at a time

Online and local co-op for up to 4 players. Open a room with a passphrase to play with friends anywhere, or share one screen at home. Each player picks a different legend and stands on the same battlefield. On one screen you can drop in mid-run with one button, and keyboard and gamepads mix freely — history doesn't end until the whole party falls.

Even in defeat, you grow

Lose a run, and your gold and achievements remain. Permanent upgrades make every run stronger, and every enemy you defeat is recorded in the bestiary. Keep playing your favorite legend, forge them stronger, and raise your own strongest.

  • Legends of history — playable heroes, each with a signature weapon and their own growth

  • Weapon evolutions shaped by each legend's myth

  • Battlefields with historical gimmicks (ice, fog, terracotta soldiers, narrow passes)

  • Online and local co-op for up to 4 (passphrase rooms online; one screen with drop-in and keyboard + gamepad mix)

  • Hordes that flood the screen — thousands of enemies at once

  • Permanent upgrades and a bestiary — progress persists through defeat

  • Full keyboard / gamepad support with rebindable controls

And all the legends, and all the battlefields, are waiting.

Who's the strongest in history? Settle it on the battlefield.

Streaming and Video Content

You're welcome to stream and make videos of this game.

  • Live streams, recorded videos, clips, and Shorts are all fine to publish.

  • You may monetize your content — ad revenue, channel memberships, Super Chats, tips, and similar features are all allowed.

  • No permission or notice is required, before or after. There are no spoiler restrictions.

  • This applies to individual creators, companies, and talent-agency members alike.

  • If you can, we'd appreciate a link to the game's Steam store page in your stream or video description (optional).

Please don't redistribute or sell the game's assets (images, audio, etc.) on their own, separately from covering the game.

IMITATORS is a co-op psychological horror where paranoia becomes your closest companion. Just an ordinary crate, chair or statue? In this game any object can come alive and end your life.

📦 ABOUT THE GAME

  • Total randomness: The map is generated randomly every round. You will never know in advance where anything is.

  • Item hunt: Your goal is to find the required object and send it up the tube. Is the object too huge? Cut it into pieces with a laser so it fits into the tube!

  • They are everywhere: Mimics hide among hundreds of objects. They blend in perfectly with their surroundings and wait for the perfect moment to attack.

  • Light is life: Mimics can attack only in absolute darkness. Stay close to the lamps and use your flashlight to stop an attack.

🎮 GAME MODES

  • 👥 Co-op (up to 6 players, playable solo): Team up with friends against bots. With every level you complete, the map grows bigger and the number of aggressive bots increases.

  • ⚔️ Multiplayer (up to 20 players): A “Humans vs Mimics” format. Take the mimics’ side: take the shape of any object, set up cunning ambushes and terrify humans with creepy jumpscares!

About This Game

You are a Recover Unit.

A maintenance sphere dispatched to reactivate an abandoned orbital station after a catastrophic power failure.

Gravity has collapsed.

Life support is failing.

Fifteen emergency generator units remain dormant across the station.

Your objective is simple:

Restore twelve of them before the station dies forever.

As you descend deeper into the facility, the mission begins to contradict itself.

Maintenance logs reference personnel that never existed.

Recovered fuel behaves like living tissue.

The emergency generators appear to consume far more than energy.

Something beneath the station has been waiting.

Not asleep.

Waiting.

Explore interconnected industrial sectors including

• Command Center

• Cryogenic Storage

• Botanical Laboratory

• Biological Containment

• Manufacturing Complex

• Maintenance Tunnels

• Docking Array

Every area hides fragments of a forgotten operation whose true purpose was erased long before your arrival.

The deeper you travel,

the less certain it becomes

whether you are restoring the station—

or completing the final stage of an experiment.

Features

* Explore a massive interconnected space station

* Collect CFL canisters to restore emergency power systems

* Piece together environmental storytelling and classified documents

* Traverse industrial machinery, maintenance shafts and abandoned laboratories

* Encounter surreal dreamlike sequences beyond physical reality

* Experience a cosmic horror narrative built on implication rather than explanation

* Discover multiple layers of meaning hidden beneath routine maintenance

There are no heroes here.

Only systems.

Only functions.

Only things that continue long after their creators disappear.

The station remembers.

It is waiting for someone

to finish the work.

You wake inside an unfinished comic, with paper underfoot and ink lines all around. Trace outlines by hand in your sketchbook to create tools and weapons. Every stroke costs ink, and your accuracy matters.

YOU DRAW WHAT YOU NEED

There is no crafting menu. You open your sketchbook, and on the page are grey guide lines in the shape

of an axe. You trace them by hand. And then you are holding an axe.

Nothing snaps your line onto the guide. That part is you, and the page can tell how well you did.

INK IS EVERYTHING

One resource, and it is inside all of it. Every stroke drinks it. Every glyph. Every obelisk costs a

lot. Enemies splash ink when you land a hit. At night it rains ink, which tops you up and chills you at

the same time.

Explore a fixed-size world, gather materials and build shelter while managing hunger, thirst and warmth. A giant eraser occasionally sweeps across the page, temporarily erasing natural features that later regrow. The world does not permanently shrink. Obelisks create safe zones.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTS

Hunger, thirst and warmth drain the whole time. Your tools crack, then break. The Unfinished come out

after dark, and nobody coloured them in. Build a shelter that holds, or draw yourself a bed and sleep

through it.

Choose your weapon tier before tracing. Rare weapons require 10 times the materials and deal 1.5 times the damage; Legendary weapons require 50 times the materials and deal twice the damage. Both use the normal drawing ink cost and demand greater precision.

Choose from six paper-and-ink player characters, three women and three men, and meet the merchant on the page.

“Wanted: Someone to offer prayers to that house.”

It all begins with a strange part-time job listing posted online.

INORIGAMI HACK DOWN is a point-and-click horror escape adventure game themed around “prayer” and “hacking.”

Explore an eerie house said to bring good fortune, solve puzzles, offr your prayers, and claim happiness.

But there are also rumors that the house is a cursed haunted site...!?

And if a supernatural entity attacks you, drive it back by hacking it down before the curse kills you.

Features

Classic Point-and-Click Adventure Gameplay

The core system is classic and easy to understand. Click around the environment to collect clues and items, and solve puzzles to progress.

Supernatural Threats That Strike Without Warning

When you encounter a supernatural entity, a countdown begins. If the timer reaches zero, it’s game over. You must repel the entity before time runs out.

Fight Supernatural Entities Through Hacking

Treat supernatural entities as clusters of data, exploit their vulnerabilities, and dive into their inner structure. Strike at the root of their grudges and Hack Down (drive back) the entity.

A Story of Four Characters Told in a Comic-Inspired Style

A distinctive comic-inspired presentation tells the story of four people invited to the mysterious house said to bring happiness.

What awaits you in INORIGAMI HACK DOWN?

The occult and science. Mystery and supernatural entities. Curses and prayers. Life and death.

Witness what lies beyond them all!

Disclosure of AI-Generated Content

To ensure transparency so you can enjoy the game with peace of mind, I want to be clear about how generative AI was used in this project. AI was used strictly as a tool to improve efficiency and help with localization.

English Translation: The original Japanese script was 100% written by me. However, I used generative AI to assist in translating that text into English.

Regarding Streaming & Derivative Works

Streaming to the ending is welcome: You are free to publish or live-stream gameplay videos all the way to the end of the game.

Monetization is allowed: Monetizing your videos using standard features of platforms like YouTube is perfectly fine.

Spoiler warnings required: To protect the experience for new players, please clearly indicate "Spoilers" in your video title, thumbnail, or intro.

Fan art is welcome: We encourage derivative works! However, please refrain from directly reusing in-game assets or creating new games based on this title's IP.

For full details, please check the complete guidelines on the Steam Community forums or our official blog.

A Short, Focused Horror Experience

INTUS is a self-contained psychological horror experience designed to be completed in approximately 30–35 minutes. It focuses on atmosphere, unsettling encounters, and a disturbing story rather than lengthy gameplay.

Afraid of losing your job, you agree to take on an urgent assignment over the weekend. You find a cheap apartment, book it for a couple of nights, and bring your laptop.

All you have to do is finish your work before Monday.

A Job to Finish

You work remotely for BELPHOR, a company that develops domestic robots.

From your laptop, you'll operate a small inspection robot, test its systems, examine different environments, and complete reports for the company.

Make Yourself at Home

The apartment has everything you need for the weekend.

Prepare your dinner, watch some television, get some sleep, and return to your assignments whenever you're ready.

Just One More Night

You still have work to finish, and your boss is expecting those reports.

INTUS is a short, story-driven horror experience built around everyday routines, remote work, and the discomfort of being somewhere you don't quite belong.

Iron Eden blends Roguelite progression, Loot Shooter mechanics, and deep Mech Customization into a unique experience where every run shapes your machine and your strategy.

Defeat dangerous enemies, collect weapons, torsos, reactors, modules, and legs, then assemble powerful builds from a near-endless combination of parts. Experiment with different loadouts, adapt to new challenges, and discover unexpected synergies between equipment and playstyles.

Features

  • Deep modular mech customization

  • Huge variety of weapons, modules, and equipment

  • Procedural levels filled with secrets and exploration

  • Procedurally animated mech legs and movement systems

  • Unique weapons with distinct behaviors and combat roles

  • Intelligent enemies that challenge your tactics

  • Atmospheric world-building and environmental storytelling

  • Endless build experimentation and replayability

  • Roguelite progression focused on discovery and adaptation

As development continues, your feedback is invaluable. Every bug report, suggestion, and piece of feedback helps shape Iron Eden into something even greater.

Thank you for joining us on this journey through the ruins of Iron Eden.

In a near-future dominated by ruthless AI legions, the remnants of humanity hide deep within the underground city known as the Underworld.

You are Iron Shadow — the lone machine that chose to stand with humanity. Against the endless waves of enemies, your only mission is simple yet absolute: survive.

This is not just another survival game. Iron Shadow: Survival Protocol blends the tense progression of the survivor genre with the mobility and precision of a platformer. Every run demands agility, quick decisions, and relentless combat.

Hybrid Combat

Survival mechanics fused with platformer action. Auto-attacks are just the beginning — dash, roll, and leap across the battlefield to outmaneuver relentless AI swarms.

Weapon Upgrade & Meta Progression

Collect weapons during battle, upgrade them, and unlock new levels of power. Combine augments and skills to create unique builds and fresh strategies every run.

Dystopian Sci-Fi World

A world where AI legions dominate the surface and humanity hides below. Experience a hardboiled narrative of a lone machine fighting for mankind, brought to life with silhouette visuals and a stark sci-fi art style.

Endless Survival

The enemy never stops coming. Waves grow stronger with time. The question is not whether you can win — it’s how long you can endure.

Iskra is a small, intimate visual novel — closer to a meditative, atmospheric experience than to conventional gameplay. Its aim is immersion: in mood, in symbolism, in depth.

You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

Iskra is steeped in a rather dark, grotesque aesthetic. You'll encounter iconic characters from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland — the White Rabbit, the Caterpillar, the Red Queen, the Cheshire Cat, the Mad Hatter — but shown as if in a distorting mirror. You'll also meet others who don't appear in Lewis Carroll's original at all, yet are known from legend and myth and carry a powerful, archetypal symbolism.

The character portraits are hand-drawn; their style is striking, and it etches itself into memory

"Nikki… Nikki, damn it… can you hear me? Wake up… please…"

Welcome to Nairhad — the sunken city that never stopped breathing. IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in the drowned ruins of a forgotten metropolis.
You awaken in silence, alone… but never truly alone.

Face the cult that worships the abyss.
Fight twisted creatures born in salt and madness.
And uncover the fragmented memories of a man who may no longer be himself.

Every corridor is a secret.
Every shadow is a whisper.
And something — something beneath the water — is waiting.

The city sleeps… but the water remembers.

Nairhad isn’t just a location — it’s a living tomb.
You’ll walk through flooded corridors, derelict chambers, and crumbling monuments of a civilization that tried to forget itself.

Light is rare. Oxygen is precious. And silence is never complete.

Every corner holds a secret.
Every step pulls you deeper.

Violence is not always the answer. But silence… often is.

Use darkness to your advantage. Lure enemies into traps. Disable lights. Distract with noise.

IT BEGAN rewards patience, precision, and fear.

You are not a soldier. You are the only one left who can disappear.

Who were you before Nairhad took you in?

As you navigate the ruins, echoes of your past surface through broken machinery, scattered notes, and hallucinations.

Memories twist. Reality bends.

The truth isn’t waiting to be found — it’s waiting to be remembered.

You were never meant to return. But the cult remembers.

Fanatics lurk in the deep, protecting something ancient.
Creatures shift in the shadows — born not of flesh, but of water, bone, and madness.

Every enemy has a purpose. Every encounter, a cost.

Some are waiting to kill you.
Others… to wake you.

Just survive and find answers in this world

Every IT career starts with a ticket.

Reset passwords, fix printers, answer impossible questions, and somehow keep the company running one click at a time.

IT Outage Desk is a humorous incremental clicker where you build an IT department from a single help desk technician into a technology empire. Hire staff, automate ticket resolution, upgrade your infrastructure, and climb the corporate ladder as the problems become bigger, stranger, and far more ridiculous.

What begins with forgotten passwords and broken printers eventually grows into company wide outages, executive emergencies, and technology disasters that nobody can explain.

Features

  • Resolve over 1,000 unique IT tickets.

  • Experience 500+ random events that can help your department or throw everything into chaos.

  • Hire staff to automate ticket resolution and expand your IT operation.

  • Upgrade your infrastructure from a small office to a massive technology network.

  • Unlock achievements, prestige bonuses, and cosmetic customizations.

  • Keep making progress while you're away with offline progression.

Whether you've spent years working in IT or you've only heard the stories, you'll probably recognize more of these tickets than you'd like to admit.

From one logic gate to a computer.


IT THINKS! is a hands-on hardware puzzle game about building a computer from the ground up. Place parts, draw wires, watch signals move, and prove each design on a live test bench. Your first component is NAND: a tiny logic gate with two inputs and one output. From there, your designs grow into arithmetic, memory, a programmable processor, parallel cores, matrix multiplication, and finally a chip that recognizes the shapes you draw.

Every part can be built from NAND, or licensed from the factory when you would rather keep moving, and you can always come back and build it yourself.

Build it. Test it. Ship it.


  • Complete 62 handcrafted contracts across six eras, from a small workshop to an AI lab.
  • Turn working circuits into reusable chips and build a catalogue of components you designed yourself.
  • Program the hardware you built with a compact assembly language and run the same kernel across many cores.
  • Balance real architectural trade-offs such as area, speed, memory bandwidth, power, and parallel efficiency.
  • Learn at your own pace with optional hints, short concept lessons, the Master's Notebook, and tests that let you skip what you already know.
  • Show off every solution with exportable die views and looping GIF captures.

No electrical-engineering background is required. You learn by building: try something, see what happened, and improve it.

Beyond the campaign


  • Build your own devices on the free bench. Add buttons, a keypad, seven-segment displays, a 16×16 lamp matrix, a buzzer, and dice, then switch to the front panel and use what you made. A bench holds up to 4,000 parts.
  • Share a device with a link. Anyone who opens it can press its buttons in a browser, with no account.
  • Take client orders between contracts and grow your workshop through nine levels.
  • Solve a new puzzle every day and see where your design ranks.
  • Play community puzzles and publish your own.

Coming from the demo? Your progress carries into the full game: automatically from the Steam demo, or with a save file from the browser demo.

Make it comfortable: six colour palettes or your own, a choice of typefaces including two high-legibility fonts, and full controller support.

Languages: The interface, lessons, and all in-game text are available in all 22 languages listed on the store page.

We taught sand to think.

ICE CREAM SHOP SIMULATOR
Open your dream ice cream shop in a bustling seaside resort and prepare for delicious chaos! Manage every aspect, from crafting artisanal ice cream to satisfying unpredictable and incredibly demanding customers.

BECOME AN ICE CREAM MASTER
Take orders, mix fresh ingredients, cook bases, churn your ice cream to perfection, and create colorful cones with different flavors and toppings! Don't forget creamy milkshakes for the most discerning palates and much more. Every detail counts to win over your customers.

CUSTOMIZE AND EXPAND YOUR EMPIRE
Give your shop a unique touch! Customize the decor, choose the most extravagant decorations, and expand your space to welcome more and more ice cream lovers. Manage stock, order new ingredients, and grow your business.

FACE CRAZY CUSTOMERS (EVEN IN CO-OP!)
Every customer has an explosive personality and absurd requests. Serve them at your best, solo or by unleashing delirium in online co-op for up to 6 players! Laughter and friendly arguments guaranteed as you try not to mess everything up.

NON-STOP CHAOS ON THE COAST
Your ice cream shop is the center of a vibrant world. Explore, decorate, and prepare for a relentless flow of hilarious situations. Ice cream is just the beginning of your worries!
